title: TestTheStoresFetchStartsNoMaintenanceInTheRepositoryItWritesTo fails on hosts whose git starts no auto-maintenance
body: internal/runstate/maintenance_test.go's control arm ("a plain git fetch in the armed repository started no maintenance") fails on this host, red at the base commit 06c6cabc with my changes stashed, so make test cannot pass here regardless of any tick's work. It is the same class as finding 1bb7d876 against xte (TestTheHarnessStartsNoGitItDoesNotWaitFor, later fixed by 6a12473f), which fixed reconcile's copy and gitbin but not this runstate fixture: the arming config keys evidently do not make this host's git start loose-object maintenance on a plain fetch.
